# Feature: Play rules cards & effects catalog

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-02 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent

Extend the Spielregeln modal with a data-driven **Karten & Effekte** catalog (all V5 pack card types + Formel-Kombinationen) and a header filter **Regel | Karten** beside Kopieren, so playtesters can jump between rule prose and card effect reference.

Roadmap: ad-hoc UX (Stufe B) — Playtest rule reference + card catalog.

## Preconditions

- App open; Solo match on board; Spielregeln modal available (`play-rules-open`)
- V5 pack is the play default (`V5_PACK`)

## Happy Path

- [ ] Modal header shows filter **Regel** | **Karten** | **Alles** (`data-testid="play-rules-filter"`) next to **Kopieren**
- [ ] **Regel** shows existing V5 draft sections; pure cards mega-section is hidden
- [ ] **Karten** shows the cards catalog only (`data-testid="play-rules-cards-catalog"` / id `play-rules-cards`); rule sections hidden; scroll resets to catalog top
- [ ] **Alles** shows rules then full catalog (`play-rules-regeln-view` + `play-rules-cards-catalog`); includes elements, ultis, formula combos, arenas, effects, artifacts
- [ ] Catalog lists categories: Element, Glitch, Charakter, Ulti/Großformel, Formel (Technik/Essenz/Katalysator), Formel-Kombinationen, Gegenstand, Arena, Artefakt — sourced from pack defs / combo catalog, not hardcoded fake effects
- [ ] Each catalog subsection has section copy; header **Kopieren** copies the active filter view (rules, cards, or both) incl. non-empty comments
- [ ] Per-section comment textareas still persist under `letz-fetz:play-rules-section-comments`

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Switching filter resets modal body scroll to top
- [ ] Empty comments omitted from copy
- [ ] Clipboard failure → no false „Kopiert!“
- [ ] Combo catalog version noted in Formel-Kombinationen intro when available

## Regression

- [ ] Existing V5 rule sections / comments / section copy still work under **Regel**
- [ ] Log / Gegner toolbar unchanged
- [ ] `npm run build` and relevant unit tests green

## Assumptions

- UI catalog of existing pack effectText — no V5 draft rule-doc sync required
- Filter-scoped copy (not always full rules+cards)
- All 744 Formel-Kombinationen listed (data-driven); grouped by combo type for readability
